thought.text: Health endpoint, portal, and workspace login all respond correctly with proper Host-based routing. Now let me verify deeper behavior: page content, Hocuspocus WS, Mongo database state, and logs.

reasoning_content:
Let's continue with the verification. Things to do:
1. Confirm that middleware domain routing works (Host: urbankit.de → /de, Host: app.urbankit.de → /de/login) — already done, both return 200.
2. Confirm that the Hocuspocus WebSocket server responds on port 1234.
3. Verify the actual page content (not just status codes) — fetch the portal's homepage and the login page and check that they're rendered (SSR content, not just an empty shell).
4. Check the mongo health check and DB existence — verify that the urban_kit database exists.
5. Check the mailpit status.
6. Confirm that the web container's health check is healthy.
7. Verify that the seed data exists (the guide mentions a seed script; the base install might have seeded prototype accounts — the summary says the seed:demo demo account is "not done", but that's optional).
8. Check hocuspocus readiness in the logs.

Also, check whether NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL are baked into the client bundle — check the container's .next static files for the values.

Let's run these checks.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo '--- portal homepage (urbankit.de) content check ---' && curl -sS -H 'Host: urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/de | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -3; curl -sS -H 'Host: urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/de | grep -oE 'urbankit|Stadt|partizip|Partizip' | sort | uniq -c | head; echo '--- login page (app.urbankit.de) ---' && curl -sS -H 'Host: app.urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/de/login | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -3; curl -sS -H 'Host: app.urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/de/login | grep -oE 'password|E-Mail|login|Login|Anmeldung' | sort | uniq -c | head
